context: Tests whether the storekit skill handles a focused consumable purchase without loading unrelated subscription, offer, compliance, or architecture work.

checklist.name: Existing architecture
checklist.description: Preserves the existing StoreManager and uses PurchaseAction or its equivalent verified custom purchase boundary instead of creating a second store architecture.

checklist.name: Purchase results and verification
checklist.description: Handles success, pending, user cancellation, and failure distinctly and verifies the transaction before granting coins.

checklist.name: Fulfillment before finish
checklist.description: Persists or reconciles coin delivery idempotently before finish and leaves failed delivery recoverable through updates or unfinished transactions.

checklist.name: Consumable entitlement boundary
checklist.description: States that Transaction.currentEntitlements is not consumable balance or delivery history and defines app/server ownership of the balance.

checklist.name: Focused routing
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated subscription, offer, App Review, and architecture changes while using a non-personal stable appAccountToken when supported.
